issues.description: Parameter identifier names for Bitmap24::set differ between the header declaration and the implementation across repositories: in the template's Bitmap24.hpp the set() declaration names the first two parameters (int i_x, int i_y) while the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp (and the usage in main.cpp) clearly treat them as (i_y, i_x). The solution repository uses the (i_y, i_x) naming. This inconsistent naming of the same conceptual parameters (row/column vs. column/row) across header, implementation and usage can create unnecessary mapping confusion for students reading the API vs. the implementation and examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter names consistent across header, implementation and usage. Update the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to use the same names/order as the implementation and callers (int i_y, int i_x, char i_r, char i_g, char i_b) so the header, cpp and example usage all present the same conceptual ordering (row, column).
